test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Lucky
solution:
The correct answer is **'Auspicious'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A term or phrase that has the exact same meaning as another word or phrase in the same language is said to be a synonym.
 
• The correct meaning of the word 'lucky' is auspicious or fortunate or blessed.
 
• The word 'auspicious' means fortunate, lucky, or prosperous implying at the immediate success or prosperity likely to occur in the near future.
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for the word 'lucky' is 'auspicious'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The synonyms of other words are as follows:

 
• **Outrageous:** Shocking; Scandalous; Atrocious
 
• **Jealous:** Envious; Begrudging; Resentful
 
• **Ominous: **Inauspicious; Portentous; Menacing
